title: 2010 年全国硕士研究生招生考试 英语（二）

sections.title: Section I　完形填空
sections.dir: Read the following text. Choose the best word(s) for each numbered blank and mark A, B, C or D on ANSWER SHEET 1. (10 points)
sections.note: 主线：甲流从被宣布为全球流行病到美国进入疫苗应对。全篇按时间推进，空多考“上下文对应”，不是孤立词义。

paras.en: The outbreak of swine flu that was first detected in Mexico was declared a global epidemic on June 11, 2009. It is the first worldwide epidemic 1 by the World Health Organization in 41 years.
paras.zh: 2009 年 6 月 11 日，最初发现于墨西哥的猪流感爆发被宣布为全球性流行病。这是世界卫生组织 41 年来 1 的首个全球性流行病。

paras.en: The heightened alert 2 an emergency meeting with flu experts in Geneva that assembled after a sharp rise in cases in Australia, and rising 3 in Britain, Japan, Chile and elsewhere.
paras.zh: 这次警戒升级 2 在日内瓦召开的流感专家紧急会议之后；会议是在澳大利亚病例急剧增多、英国、日本、智利等地感染人数不断 3 之后召集的。

paras.en: But the epidemic is " 4 " in severity, according to Margaret Chan, the organization's director general, 5 the overwhelming majority of patients experiencing only mild symptoms and a full recovery, often in the 6 of any medical treatment.
paras.zh: 但据世卫组织总干事陈冯富珍说，这次流行病在严重程度上" 4 "，5 绝大多数患者只有轻微症状并能完全康复，而且往往是在 6 任何药物治疗的情况下康复的。

paras.en: The outbreak came to global 7 in late April 2009, when Mexican authorities noted an unusually large number of hospitalizations and deaths 8 healthy adults. As much of Mexico City shut down at the height of a panic, cases began to 9 in New York City, the southwestern United States and around the world.
paras.zh: 2009 年 4 月下旬，这次爆发引起全球 7 ：当时墨西哥当局注意到健康成年人 8 出现了异常多的住院和死亡病例。在恐慌达到顶点、墨西哥城大部分地区关闭之际，病例开始在纽约市、美国西南部以及世界各地 9 。

paras.en: In the United States, new cases seemed to fade 10 warmer weather arrived. But in late September 2009, officials reported there was 11 flu activity in almost every state and that virtually all the 12 tested are the new swine flu, also known as A(H1N1), not seasonal flu. In the U.S., it has 13 more than one million people, and caused more than 600 deaths and more than 6,000 hospitalizations.
paras.zh: 在美国，新病例似乎 10 天气转暖而逐渐减少。但到了 2009 年 9 月下旬，官员报告几乎每个州都有 11 的流感活动，而且几乎所有被检测的 12 都是新型猪流感，即甲型 H1N1 流感，而不是季节性流感。在美国，它已经 13 一百多万人，造成 600 多人死亡、6000 多人住院。

paras.en: Federal health officials 14 Tamiflu for children from the national stockpile and began 15 orders from the states for the new swine flu vaccine. The new vaccine, which is different from the annual flu vaccine, is 16 ahead of expectations. More than three million doses were to be made available in early October 2009, though most of those 17 doses were of the FluMist nasal spray type, which is not 18 for pregnant women, people over 50 or those with breathing difficulties, heart disease or several other 19 . But it was still possible to vaccinate people in other high-risk groups: health care workers, people 20 infants and healthy young people.
paras.zh: 联邦卫生官员从国家储备中 14 了用于儿童的达菲，并开始 15 各州对新型猪流感疫苗的订单。这种新型疫苗不同于每年接种的流感疫苗，16 得早于预期。2009 年 10 月初将有三百多万剂投放使用，不过这些 17 疫苗大多是 FluMist 鼻喷剂型，不 18 孕妇、50 岁以上人群以及有呼吸困难、心脏病或其他若干 19 的人使用。但仍可为其他高危人群接种：医护人员、20 婴幼儿的人以及健康的年轻人。

items.exp: 定位首段第二句 It is the first worldwide epidemic 1 by the World Health Organization in 41 years。空格是被动语态的谓语，"41 年来首个"由世卫组织"认定"，designate 正有"指定、认定"之义。appoint 只能接"人"（任命某人），criticize、comment 与客观陈述语气冲突。
定位第二段首句 The heightened alert 2 an emergency meeting...that assembled after a sharp rise in cases。会议在疫情恶化之后召开，警戒升级又在会议之后，故 followed。prompted 把因果说反——促使开会的是疫情而非"警觉"；proceeded 不能以 meeting 为宾语。
定位同句 and rising 3 in Britain, Japan, Chile and elsewhere，与前面 a sharp rise in cases 并列，指“感染人数”上升，numbers 是唯一能指人数的词。digits 指 0–9 的数位，amounts 多接不可数名词，sums 指金额或总和。
定位第三段 But the epidemic is " 4 " in severity。后文 with the overwhelming majority of patients experiencing only mild symptoms 就是解释：病情不重，故 moderate（中等的）。extreme 与"症状轻微、完全康复"直接矛盾，normal 说的是"是否正常"而非"严重程度"。
定位同句 5 the overwhelming majority of patients experiencing only mild symptoms。这是“with + 名词 + 现在分词”的独立主格结构，作原因状语说明“为何说程度中等”，只有 with 能引导。in/from/by 都无法构成这一结构，句子会缺谓语。
定位同句 often in the 6 of any medical treatment，与“完全康复”呼应，指“在没有任何治疗的情况下”也能好，in the absence of 是固定搭配。in the presence of 意为“当着……的面”，in progress 意为“在进行中”，in favor of 意为“支持”，均不通。
定位第四段首句 The outbreak came to global 7 in late April 2009，冒号后的分句说墨西哥当局"注意到"大量住院与死亡，正是"引起全球注意"的展开，come to sb's notice 为固定搭配。come to reality、phenomenon 都不成搭配，concept 更无此用法。
定位同句 hospitalizations and deaths 8 healthy adults，指“健康成年人当中”的住院与死亡，among 表示“在……群体之中”。over 表“超过”、for 表“对于”、to 表方向，都无法表达“群体范围”这一关系。
定位第四段末句 cases began to 9 in New York City...and around the world，与墨西哥城“关闭”对照，指病例在别处“突然冒出来”，crop up 意为“突然出现”。stay up（熬夜）、fill up（装满）、cover up（掩盖）与“病例”都不搭配。
定位第五段首句 new cases seemed to fade 10 warmer weather arrived，两者是“随着……而”的伴随关系，as 引导时间状语从句。until 会变成“直到天暖才减少”，与下一句 But...officials reported 的转折逻辑打架；if/unless 表条件，此处并无假设意味。
定位第五段 there was 11 flu activity in almost every state，but 转折说明与"病例减少"相反：流感活动"显著、值得注意"，significant 正合。excessive 含"过度"贬义且不与 activity 搭配，enormous 强调体积数量，magnificent 形容"壮观"。
定位同句 virtually all the 12 tested are the new swine flu，tested 之前需要“被检测的（化验样本）”，sample 正指化验取样。categories（类别）、examples（例子）、patterns（模式）都不能被“检测”，也无法与 tested 构成“检测样本”之意。
定位同句 it has 13 more than one million people，it 指病毒，与后面 caused more than 600 deaths 并列，指“感染”了百万人，infect 正确。inject（注射）方向相反，impart（传授、赋予）与 immerse（浸入）都不能以“人”为宾语表“传染”。
定位第六段首句 Federal health officials 14 Tamiflu for children from the national stockpile，从国家储备中"发放"药物，release...from 表"从……中放出、发放"。relay（转达）、relieve（缓解）、remain 都不能带 from the stockpile 这一来源。
定位 began 15 orders from the states for the new swine flu vaccine。主语是联邦官员，宾语是"来自各州的订单"，只能"接受订单"，take orders 为固定搭配。place/give orders 是"下订单"，方向相反；deliver orders 是"交付订货"，与 from the states 冲突。
定位 is 16 ahead of expectations，紧接着 More than three million doses were to be made available 原词复现，指疫苗"可供使用"的时间早于预期。feasible（可行）、reliable（可靠）、applicable（适用）都不能与 ahead of expectations 搭配表"提前上市"。
定位 most of those 17 doses，上文刚说“10 月初首批三百多万剂”，这里指“最初的那批”，initial 与 early October 呼应。prevalent（流行的）、principal（主要的）、innovative（创新的）都不能表达“第一批投放”的时间含义。
定位 which is not 18 for pregnant women, people over 50 or those with breathing difficulties，be recommended for sb 意为"建议某人使用"，与后面列举的几类不宜人群吻合。presented/restricted/introduced 与 for 搭配后都不表示"建议使用"。
定位 those with breathing difficulties, heart disease or several other 19，空格需与“呼吸困难”“心脏病”并列，同属疾病，problem 可作“疾病”讲（health problems）。issues 指议题，agonies、sufferings 指痛苦感受，都不是病名。
定位末句 health care workers, people 20 infants and healthy young people，与"医护人员""健康年轻人"并列的高危人群是"照看婴幼儿的人"，care for 意为"照料"。involved in（卷入）、concerned with（关心）、warding off（避开）都不能说明这些人为何属高危。

sections.title: Text 1　艺术品市场的衰退
sections.dir: Read the text and answer the questions by choosing A, B, C or D.
sections.note: 主线：赫斯特专场成了市场由盛转衰的分水岭。第 23 题选"错"，B 把"汇聚方式少有匹敌"偷换成"势头超过同行"。

paras.en: The longest bull run in a century of art-market history ended on a dramatic note with a sale of 56 works by Damien Hirst, Beautiful Inside My Head Forever, at Sotheby's in London on September 15th 2008. All but two pieces sold, fetching more than £70m, a record for a sale by a single artist. It was a last victory. As the auctioneer called out bids, in New York one of the oldest banks on Wall Street, Lehman Brothers, filed for bankruptcy.
paras.zh: 艺术品市场一个世纪以来最长的牛市，以戏剧性的方式收场：2008 年 9 月 15 日，伦敦苏富比拍卖行举办达米恩·赫斯特（Damien Hirst）《我心中永存的美丽》专场，拍出 56 件作品。除两件外全部成交，成交额超过 7000 万英镑，创下单个艺术家专场拍卖的纪录。这是一场"最后的胜利"。就在拍卖师喊出竞价之际，纽约华尔街最古老的银行之一雷曼兄弟申请破产。

paras.en: The world art market had already been losing momentum for a while after rising bewilderingly since 2003. At its peak in 2007 it was worth some $65 billion, reckons Clare McAndrew, founder of Arts Economics, a research firm - double the figure five years earlier. Since then it may have come down to $50 billion. But the market generates interest far beyond its size because it brings together great wealth, enormous egos, greed, passion and controversy in a way matched by few other industries.
paras.zh: 世界艺术品市场自 2003 年以来令人费解地上涨之后，其实已经失去势头有一段时间了。研究公司"艺术经济学"创始人克莱尔·麦克安德鲁（Clare McAndrew）估算，2007 年顶峰时市场总值约 650 亿美元，是五年前的两倍。此后它可能已跌至 500 亿美元。但这个市场引发的关注远远超出它的规模，因为它把巨额财富、极度的自负、贪婪、激情与争议汇聚在一起，少有其他行业能与之相比。

paras.en: In the weeks and months that followed Mr. Hirst's sale, spending of any sort became deeply unfashionable. In the art world that meant collectors stayed away from galleries and salerooms. Sales of contemporary art fell by two-thirds, and in the most overheated sector, they were down by nearly 90% in the year to November 2008. Within weeks the world's two biggest auction houses, Sotheby's and Christie's, had to pay out nearly $200m in guarantees to clients who had placed works for sale with them.
paras.zh: 在赫斯特拍卖会之后的数周乃至数月里，任何形式的消费都变得极不合时宜。在艺术界，这意味着收藏家远离画廊和拍卖场。当代艺术品的销售额下滑了三分之二，在最过热的板块，截至 2008 年 11 月的一年里跌幅接近 90%。几周之内，全球最大的两家拍卖行苏富比和佳士得，不得不向把作品交给它们拍卖的客户支付近 2 亿美元的保证金。

paras.en: The current downturn in the art market is the worst since the Japanese stopped buying Impressionists at the end of 1989. This time experts reckon that prices are about 40% down on their peak on average, though some have been far more fluctuant. But Edward Dolman, Christie's chief executive, says: "I'm pretty confident we're at the bottom."
paras.zh: 艺术品市场当前的这轮下滑，是自 1989 年底日本人停止购买印象派作品以来最严重的一次。这一次专家估计，价格较峰值平均下跌约 40%，不过有些作品的波动幅度要大得多。但佳士得首席执行官爱德华·多尔曼（Edward Dolman）说："我相当确信我们已经触底。"

paras.en: What makes this slump different from the last, he says, is that there are still buyers in the market. Almost everyone who was interviewed for this special report said that the biggest problem at the moment is not a lack of demand but a lack of good work to sell. The three Ds - death, debt and divorce - still deliver works of art to the market. But anyone who does not have to sell is keeping away, waiting for confidence to return.
paras.zh: 他说，这次暴跌与上一次的不同之处在于，市场上仍然有买家。几乎所有接受本专题报道采访的人都说，眼下最大的问题不是缺少需求，而是缺少可供出售的好作品。"3D"——死亡、债务、离婚——依然把艺术品送进市场。但凡是并非非卖不可的人，都在远离市场，等待信心回归。

items.stem: In the first paragraph, Damien Hirst's sale was referred to as "a last victory" because
opts: the art market had witnessed a succession of victories
the auctioneer finally got the two pieces at the highest bids
Beautiful Inside My Head Forever won over all masterpieces
it was successfully made just before the world financial crisis
items.exp: 定位第一段③④句：It was a last victory 之后紧接 As the auctioneer called out bids, ... Lehman Brothers, filed for bankruptcy。雷曼破产即 2008 年危机开端，故"最后的胜利"指这场拍卖赶在危机前成功举办，D 正确。B 把 All but two pieces sold 曲解为"以最高价拍得两件"。

items.stem: By saying "spending of any sort became deeply unfashionable" (Line 1-2, Para. 3), the author suggests that
opts: collectors were no longer actively involved in art-market auctions
people stopped every kind of spending and stayed away from galleries
art collection as a fashion had lost its appeal to a great extent
works of art in general had gone out of fashion so they were not worth buying
items.exp: 定位第三段①②句：spending of any sort became deeply unfashionable 之后紧跟 In the art world that meant collectors stayed away from galleries and salerooms，即收藏家不再积极参与拍卖，A 是其同义改写。B 的 stopped every kind of spending 过于绝对，C 的 as a fashion 文中无据。

items.stem: Which of the following statements is NOT true?
opts: Sales of contemporary art fell dramatically from 2007 to 2008.
The art market surpassed many other industries in momentum.
The art market generally went downward in various ways.
Some art dealers were awaiting better chances to come.
items.exp: 定位第二段①④句：①句说市场 losing momentum，④句说它汇聚财富、自负与争议的方式 matched by few other industries——比的是"汇聚方式"，不是"势头超过其他行业"，B 偷换了比较对象。A、C、D 分别对应第三段跌幅、多组下跌数据与末句 waiting for confidence to return。

items.stem: The three Ds mentioned in the last paragraph are
items.exp: 定位第五段③句 The three Ds - death, debt and divorce - still deliver works of art to the market。deliver...to the market 即"把艺术品送进市场"，说明死亡、债务、离婚是推动艺术品流通的因素，C 正确。D 借第四段的 Impressionists 设陷，与 3D 无关；A、B 无据。

items.stem: The most appropriate title for this text could be
items.exp: 全文脉络：首段以赫斯特专场这一“最后的胜利”引出市场见顶，二、三段写失去势头与销售额、保证金的连锁下滑，四、五段写业内“已触底”的判断和买家仍在，主线就是艺术品市场的衰退，C 正确。A 只覆盖第四段的价格数据，以偏概全；D 的“兴趣转移”文中从未提及。

sections.title: Text 2　沟通不畅与婚姻危机
sections.dir: Read the text and answer the questions by choosing A, B, C or D.
sections.note: 主线：男人在外话多、在家话少，这种不对称伤婚姻。第 28 题 B 把"离婚率 50%"偷换成"50% 的离婚源于沟通失败"。

paras.en: I was addressing a small gathering in a suburban Virginia living room - a women's group that had invited men to join them. Throughout the evening, one man had been particularly talkative, frequently offering ideas and anecdotes, while his wife sat silently beside him on the couch. Toward the end of the evening, I commented that women frequently complain that their husbands don't talk to them. This man quickly nodded in agreement. He gestured toward his wife and said, "She's the talker in our family." The room burst into laughter; the man looked puzzled and hurt. "It's true," he explained. "When I come home from work I have nothing to say. If she didn't keep the conversation going, we'd spend the whole evening in silence."
paras.zh: 我曾在弗吉尼亚郊区一间客厅里的一次小型聚会上讲话——那是一个女性团体，也邀请了男性参加。整个晚上，一位男士格外健谈，频频发表见解、讲述轶事，而他的妻子静静地坐在他身旁的沙发上。聚会接近尾声时，我评论说，女性常常抱怨丈夫不跟自己说话。这位男士立刻点头赞同。他指了指妻子说："在我们家，话多的是她。"满屋哄堂大笑；他却一脸困惑和受伤。"这是真的，"他解释道，"我下班回家就无话可说。要不是她一直把话接下去，我们整晚都会在沉默中度过。"

paras.en: This episode crystallizes the irony that although American men tend to talk more than women in public situations, they often talk less at home. And this pattern is wreaking havoc with marriage.
paras.zh: 这个插曲把一种讽刺意味清晰地呈现出来：美国男性在公共场合往往比女性说得多，在家里却常常说得更少。而正是这种模式，正在严重损害婚姻。

paras.en: The pattern was observed by political scientist Andrew Hacker in the late 1970s. Sociologist Catherine Kohler Riessman reports in her new book Divorce Talk that most of the women she interviewed - but only a few of the men - gave lack of communication as the reason for their divorces. Given the current divorce rate of nearly 50 percent, that amounts to millions of cases in the United States every year - a virtual epidemic of failed conversation.
paras.zh: 这一模式早在 20 世纪 70 年代末就被政治学家安德鲁·哈克（Andrew Hacker）观察到。社会学家凯瑟琳·科勒·里斯曼（Catherine Kohler Riessman）在新书《离婚谈》中报告说，她访谈的女性大多——而男性只有少数——把缺乏交流当作离婚的原因。考虑到目前近 50% 的离婚率，这在美国每年就意味着数百万例——一场名副其实的"交谈失败"流行病。

paras.en: In my own research, complaints from women about their husbands most often focused not on tangible inequities such as having given up the chance for a career to accompany a husband to his, or doing far more than their share of daily life-support work like cleaning, cooking and social arrangements. Instead, they focused on communication: "He doesn't listen to me." "He doesn't talk to me." I found, as Hacker observed years before, that most wives want their husbands to be, first and foremost, conversational partners, but few husbands share this expectation of their wives.
paras.zh: 在我自己的研究中，女性对丈夫的抱怨往往并不集中在有形的不平等上，比如为了陪丈夫去外地而放弃自己的职业机会，或者承担了远超自己那份的日常家务——如打扫、做饭和安排社交活动。相反，她们抱怨的是交流："他不听我说话。""他不跟我说话。"正如哈克多年前观察到的那样，我发现大多数妻子希望丈夫首先是自己的交谈伙伴，但很少有丈夫对妻子抱有同样的期待。

paras.en: In short, the image that best represents the current crisis is the stereotypical cartoon scene of a man sitting at the breakfast table with a newspaper held up in front of his face, while a woman glares at the back of it, wanting to talk.
paras.zh: 简而言之，最能代表当前这场危机的情景，是那幅老套的漫画：一个男人坐在早餐桌旁，把报纸挡在面前，一个女人盯着报纸的背面，很想说点什么。

items.stem: What is most wives' main expectation of their husbands?
items.exp: 定位第四段末句 most wives want their husbands to be, first and foremost, conversational partners，first and foremost 强调这是首要期待，即希望丈夫跟自己交谈，A 正确。C、D 恰是该段①句否定的内容（妻子抱怨的不是"放弃事业""分担家务"），属反向干扰。

items.stem: Judging from the context, the phrase "wreaking havoc" (Line 3, Para. 2) most probably means
items.exp: 定位第二段末句 this pattern is wreaking havoc with marriage，this pattern 指"丈夫在家少言"；第三段紧接着用"多数女性把离婚归因于缺乏交流""每年数百万例"说明后果，可见短语意为"造成破坏"，C 正确。D 的 creating pressure 程度太轻，B 只表示"有影响"。

items.stem: All of the following are true EXCEPT
opts: men tend to talk more in public than women
nearly 50 percent of recent divorces are caused by failed conversation
women attach much importance to communication between couples
a female tends to be more talkative at home than her spouse
items.exp: 定位第三段末句 Given the current divorce rate of nearly 50 percent, that amounts to millions of cases：50% 修饰的是"离婚率"，不是"因沟通失败而离婚的比例"，B 偷换了比较对象。A、D 对应第二段首句的两种情形，C 对应第三段第二句与第四段。

items.stem: Which of the following can best summarize the main idea of this text?
opts: The moral decaying deserves more research by sociologists.
Marriage break-up stems from sex inequalities.
Husband and wife have different expectations from their marriage.
Conversational patterns between man and wife are different.
items.exp: 全文由聚会场景引出“男人在外话多、在家话少”（一、二段），再用他人研究、作者自己的调查和一幅漫画反复说明这种差异正伤害婚姻（三至五段），主线是夫妻交谈模式不同，D 正确。C 只对应第四段“对交流的期待不同”，且把“对交流的期待”泛化成“对婚姻的期待”，覆盖不了全篇；A 的“道德败坏”文中无据。

items.stem: In the following part immediately after this text, the author will most probably focus on
opts: a vivid account of the new book Divorce Talk
a detailed description of the stereotypical cartoon
other possible reasons for a high divorce rate in the U.S.
a brief introduction to the political scientist Andrew Hacker
items.exp: 定位末段：作者用一句话概括“丈夫举报纸、妻子想说话”的漫画场景便收尾，行文上留下了一个待展开的画面，下文最可能把这幅漫画细说，B 正确。A 的《离婚谈》在第三段已用过、后文未再提；C 偏离“夫妻交流”这一主线；D 的人物只是佐证材料，不是论述对象。

sections.title: Text 3　商家如何培养消费习惯
sections.dir: Read the text and answer the questions by choosing A, B, C or D.
sections.note: 主线：企业靠“日常暗示 + 广告”把使用产品变成不自觉的习惯。第 33 题小心：Unilever 是公司不是产品。

paras.en: Over the past decade, many companies had perfected the art of creating automatic behaviors - habits - among consumers. These habits have helped companies earn billions of dollars when customers eat snacks or wipe counters almost without thinking, often in response to a carefully designed set of daily cues.
paras.zh: 过去十年里，许多公司把一门技艺练得炉火纯青：在消费者身上制造自动行为——也就是习惯。当顾客几乎不假思索地吃零食、擦台面时，这些习惯往往是对一整套精心设计的日常暗示作出的反应，帮公司赚取了数十亿美元。

paras.en: "There are fundamental public health problems, like dirty hands instead of a soap habit, that remain killers only because we can't figure out how to change people's habits," said Dr. Curtis, the director of the Hygiene Center at the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine. "We wanted to learn from private industry how to create new behaviors that happen automatically."
paras.zh: "有一些根本性的公共卫生问题，比如脏手而非用肥皂洗手的习惯，它们之所以仍然是杀手，只是因为我们想不出改变人们习惯的办法，"伦敦卫生与热带医学院卫生中心主任柯蒂斯（Curtis）博士说。"我们想向私营行业学习，如何让新的行为自动发生。"

paras.en: The companies that Dr. Curtis turned to - Procter & Gamble, Colgate-Palmolive and Unilever - had invested hundreds of millions of dollars finding the subtle cues in consumers' lives that corporations could use to introduce new routines.
paras.zh: 柯蒂斯博士求助的公司——宝洁、高露洁-棕榄和联合利华——已投入数亿美元，寻找消费者生活中那些微妙的暗示，供企业用来引入新的日常惯例。

paras.en: If you look hard enough, you'll find that many of the products we use every day - chewing gums, skin moisturizers, disinfecting wipes, air fresheners, water purifiers, health snacks, teeth whiteners, fabric softeners, vitamins - are results of manufactured habits. A century ago, few people regularly brushed their teeth multiple times a day. Today, because of shrewd advertising and public health campaigns, many Americans habitually give their pearly whites a cavity-preventing scrub twice a day, often with Colgate, Crest or one of the other brands.
paras.zh: 如果你看得足够仔细，就会发现我们日常使用的许多产品——口香糖、润肤霜、消毒湿巾、空气清新剂、净水器、健康零食、牙齿美白剂、织物柔顺剂、维生素——都是"被制造出来的习惯"的产物。一个世纪前，很少有人会习惯性地一天刷好几次牙。而今天，由于精明的广告和公共卫生运动，许多美国人习惯性地每天给自己洁白的牙齿做两次防蛀刷洗，用的往往是高露洁、佳洁士或其他某个品牌。

paras.en: A few decades ago, many people didn't drink water outside of a meal. Then beverage companies started bottling the production of far-off springs, and now office workers unthinkingly sip bottled water all day long. Chewing gum, once bought primarily by adolescent boys, is now featured in commercials as a breath freshener and teeth cleanser for use after a meal. Skin moisturizers are advertised as part of morning beauty rituals, slipped in between hair brushing and putting on makeup.
paras.zh: 几十年前，许多人在吃饭以外的时间不喝水。后来，饮料公司开始把远方泉眼的水装瓶出售，如今办公室职员整天不假思索地小口喝着瓶装水。口香糖曾经主要由青春期男孩购买，如今在广告里被包装成饭后使用的口气清新剂和牙齿清洁剂。润肤霜则被宣传为早晨美容程序的一部分，悄然插入梳头与化妆之间。

paras.en: "Our products succeed when they become part of daily or weekly patterns," said Carol Berning, a consumer psychologist who recently retired from Procter & Gamble, the company that sold $76 billion of Tide, Crest and other products last year. "Creating positive habits is a huge part of improving our consumers' lives, and it's essential to making new products commercially viable."
paras.zh: "当产品成为每天或每周的固定习惯时，我们就成功了，"卡罗尔·伯宁（Carol Berning）说。她是最近从宝洁退休的消费心理学家，而宝洁去年卖出了价值 760 亿美元的汰渍、佳洁士等产品。"培养积极的习惯是改善消费者生活的重要一环，对新产品在商业上站得住脚也至关重要。"

paras.en: Through experiments and observation, social scientists like Dr. Berning have learned that there is power in tying certain behaviors to habitual cues through ruthless advertising. As this new science of habit has emerged, controversies have erupted when the tactics have been used to sell questionable beauty creams or unhealthy foods.
paras.zh: 通过实验和观察，伯宁博士这样的社会科学家已经认识到：通过无情的广告把某些行为与习惯性暗示绑定起来，是有力量的。随着这门新的习惯科学兴起，当这些手段被用来推销功效可疑的美容霜或不健康食品时，争议便爆发了。

items.stem: According to Dr. Curtis, habits like hand washing with soap
items.exp: 定位第二段①句 dirty hands instead of a soap habit ... remain killers only because we can't figure out how to change people's habits：柯蒂斯要的是把"用肥皂洗手"培养成习惯，故 A。B、C 针对的是"不用肥皂"的旧习惯，方向相反；D 与本段 public health problems 的定性冲突。

items.stem: Bottled water, chewing gum and skin moisturizers are mentioned in Paragraph 5 so as to
opts: reveal their impact on people's habits
show the urgent need of daily necessities
indicate their effect on people's buying power
manifest the significant role of good habits
items.exp: 定位第五段：三个例子都以“过去怎样、现在怎样”的对比展开，落点是商家让这些使用行为变成不自觉的日常，回应第四段首句 are results of manufactured habits，即揭示产品对人们习惯的塑造作用，A 正确。B 只看到“日用品”这一表层；C 的“购买力”文中未提；D 把“被制造的习惯”说成“好习惯”，混淆了褒贬。

items.stem: Which of the following does NOT belong to products that help create people's habits?
items.exp: 定位第三段 The companies that Dr. Curtis turned to - Procter & Gamble, Colgate-Palmolive and Unilever，Unilever 是与宝洁、高露洁并列的"公司"，不是产品，故 D 为答案。Tide、Crest 见第六段，Colgate 见第四段，都是具体产品；C 看似公司名，却在第四段作牙膏品牌出现。

items.stem: From the text we know that some of consumers' habits are developed due to
items.exp: 定位第四段 because of shrewd advertising and public health campaigns 与第七段 through ruthless advertising：习惯是广告宣传反复强化出来的，C（商业推广）正是概括。B 的 automatic behavior creation 是习惯本身的表现，不是成因；D 的实验只用于验证广告与习惯的关系。

items.stem: The author's attitude toward the influence of advertisement on people's habits is
items.exp: 定位末段：作者先承认 ruthless advertising 确能把行为固化成习惯，随即指出这些手段被用来推销 questionable beauty creams or unhealthy foods 并引发争议，一串贬义词定下否定基调，故 B。C 的唯一依据是第六段宝洁人士的话，那是被引用的商家观点。

sections.title: Text 4　美国陪审团制度的演进
sections.dir: Read the text and answer the questions by choosing A, B, C or D.
sections.note: 主线：陪审制打着民主旗号却长期排斥女性与"非精英"，1968 年法案、1975 年判例才补上。第 39 题四选项分属不同法源。

paras.en: Many Americans regard the jury system as a concrete expression of crucial democratic values, including the principles that all citizens who meet minimal qualifications of age and literacy are equally competent to serve on juries; that jurors should be selected randomly from a representative cross section of the community; that no citizen should be denied the right to serve on a jury on account of race, religion, sex, or national origin; that defendants are entitled to trial by their peers; and that verdicts should represent the conscience of the community and not just the letter of the law. The jury is also said to be the best surviving example of direct rather than representative democracy. In a direct democracy, citizens take turns governing themselves, rather than electing representatives to govern for them.
paras.zh: 许多美国人把陪审团制度视为关键民主价值观的具体体现，其中包括这些原则：所有满足最低年龄和识字要求的公民都同样有能力担任陪审员；陪审员应从具有代表性的社区各阶层中随机选出；任何公民都不应因种族、宗教、性别或民族出身而被剥夺担任陪审员的权利；被告有权接受由同侪组成的陪审团的审判；裁决应体现社区的良知，而不仅仅是法律条文。陪审团也被认为是直接民主而非代议制民主现存最好的范例。在直接民主中，公民轮流治理自己，而不是选举代表替他们治理。

paras.en: But as recently as in 1968, jury selection procedures conflicted with these democratic ideals. In some states, for example, jury duty was limited to persons of supposedly superior intelligence, education, and moral character. Although the Supreme Court of the United States had prohibited intentional racial discrimination in jury selection as early as the 1880 case of Strauder v. West Virginia, the practice of selecting so-called elite or blue-ribbon juries provided a convenient way around this and other antidiscrimination laws.
paras.zh: 但就在不远的 1968 年，陪审员的遴选程序仍与这些民主理想相冲突。例如在某些州，陪审员义务仅限于那些被认为智力、教育程度和道德品质优越的人。尽管美国最高法院早在 1880 年的斯特劳德诉西弗吉尼亚州案（Strauder v. West Virginia）中就禁止在陪审员遴选中故意实行种族歧视，但挑选所谓"精英"或"蓝带"陪审团的做法，为绕开这一规定和其他反歧视法律提供了一条便利途径。

paras.en: The system also failed to regularly include women on juries until the mid-20th century. Although women first served on state juries in Utah in 1898, it was not until the 1940s that a majority of states made women eligible for jury duty. Even then several states automatically exempted women from jury duty unless they personally asked to have their names included on the jury list. This practice was justified by the claim that women were needed at home, and it kept juries unrepresentative of women through the 1960s.
paras.zh: 直到 20 世纪中叶，这一制度也未能经常把女性纳入陪审团。尽管女性早在 1898 年就首次在犹他州担任州陪审员，但直到 20 世纪 40 年代，多数州才让女性有资格履行陪审员义务。即便那时，仍有几个州自动免除女性的陪审员义务，除非她们本人要求把自己的名字列入陪审员名单。这种做法以"家里需要女性"为由获得正当化，使陪审团直到 20 世纪 60 年代都无法代表女性。

paras.en: In 1968, the Congress of the United States passed the Jury Selection and Service Act, ushering in a new era of democratic reforms for the jury. This law abolished special educational requirements for federal jurors and required them to be selected at random from a cross section of the entire community. In the landmark 1975 decision Taylor v. Louisiana, the Supreme Court extended the requirement that juries be representative of all parts of the community to the state level. The Taylor decision also declared sex discrimination in jury selection to be unconstitutional and ordered states to use the same procedures for selecting male and female jurors.
paras.zh: 1968 年，美国国会通过了《陪审员遴选与服务法》，为陪审团的民主改革开创了新时代。该法废除了对联邦陪审员的特殊教育要求，并要求他们从整个社区的各阶层中随机选出。在 1975 年具有里程碑意义的泰勒诉路易斯安那州案（Taylor v. Louisiana）判决中，最高法院把"陪审团应代表社区各部分"这一要求扩展到了州一级。泰勒案判决还宣布陪审员遴选中的性别歧视违宪，并命令各州在遴选男女陪审员时使用相同的程序。

items.stem: From the principles of the US jury system, we learn that
opts: both literate and illiterate people can serve on juries
defendants are immune from trial by their peers
no age limit should be imposed for jury service
judgment should consider the opinion of the public
items.exp: 定位第一段原则：verdicts should represent the conscience of the community and not just the letter of the law，即裁决要体现社区良知（公众意见），D 正确。A、C 与 minimal qualifications of age and literacy 相悖，B 与 defendants are entitled to trial by their peers 相反。

items.stem: The practice of selecting so-called elite jurors prior to 1968 showed
opts: the prevalent discrimination against certain races
the conflicting ideals in jury selection procedures
the arrogance common among the Supreme Court judges
items.exp: 定位第二段③句：1880 年最高法院已禁止陪审员遴选中的种族歧视，但挑选 elite or blue-ribbon juries 却 provided a convenient way around this and other antidiscrimination laws——能绕开法律，说明反歧视法有漏洞，A 正确。C 把"与民主理想冲突"曲解为"理念自相矛盾"。

items.stem: Even in the 1960s, women were seldom on the jury list in some states because
opts: they were automatically banned by state laws
they fell far short of the required qualifications
they were supposed to perform domestic duties
they tended to evade public engagement
items.exp: 定位第三段末句 This practice was justified by the claim that women were needed at home，即女性被认为应在家操持家务，C 是这句的同义改写。A 与 automatically exempted ... unless they personally asked 不符——法律并未一概禁止；B、D 文中无据。

items.stem: After the Jury Selection and Service Act was passed,
opts: sex discrimination in jury selection was unconstitutional and had to be abolished
educational requirements became less rigid in the selection of federal jurors
jurors at the state level ought to be representative of the entire community
states ought to conform to the federal court in reforming the jury system
items.exp: 定位第四段②句 This law abolished special educational requirements for federal jurors，即对联邦陪审员的教育要求被取消、不再严格，B 正确。A 与 C 都是 1975 年 Taylor v. Louisiana 判决的内容，不是 1968 年这部法律的作用；D 无据。

items.stem: In discussing the US jury system, the text centers on
items.exp: 首段讲陪审制承载的民主原则与"直接民主"传统，二、三段讲历史上与这些理想冲突的做法（精英陪审团、排斥女性），末段讲 1968 年法案与 1975 年判决带来的改革，全文是"传统 + 发展"，D 正确。C 少了首段的制度传统，A 的 nature 涵盖不了历史演进。

sections.title: Section II Part B　判断正误（T / F）
sections.dir: Read the following text and decide whether each of the statements is true or false. Choose T if the statement is true or F if the statement is not true. Mark your answers on ANSWER SHEET 1. (10 points)
sections.note: 主线：借大雁编队省油谈客机编队的可行性与障碍。五题全在绝对化上设陷：promote、more comfortable、documented。
sections.intro:
Copying Birds May Save Aircraft Fuel

Both Boeing and Airbus have trumpeted the efficiency of their newest aircraft, the 787 and A350 respectively. Their clever designs and lightweight composites certainly make a difference. But a group of researchers at Stanford University, led by Ilan Kroo, has suggested that airlines could take a more naturalistic approach to cutting jet-fuel use and it would not require them to buy new aircraft.

The answer, says Dr. Kroo, lies with birds. Since 1914, scientists have known that birds flying in formation - a V-shape - expend less energy. The air flowing over a bird's wings curls upwards behind the wingtips, a phenomenon known as upwash. Other birds flying in the upwash experience reduced drag, and spend less energy propelling themselves. Peter Lissaman, an aeronautics expert who was formerly at Caltech and the University of Southern California, has suggested that a formation of 25 birds might enjoy a range increase of 71%.

When applied to aircraft, the principles are not substantially different. Dr. Kroo and his team modeled what would happen if three passenger jets departing from Los Angeles, San Francisco and Las Vegas were to assemble over Utah, assume an inverted V-formation, occasionally change places so all could have a turn in the most favourable positions, and proceed to London. They found that the aircraft consumed as much as 15% less fuel (coupled with a reduction in carbon-dioxide output). Nitrogen-oxide emissions during the cruising portions of the flight fell by around a quarter.

There are, of course, knots to be worked out. One consideration is safety, or at least the perception of it. Would passengers feel comfortable travelling in companion? Dr. Kroo points out that the aircraft could be separated by several nautical miles, and would not be in the intimate groupings favoured by display teams like the Red Arrows. A passenger peering out of the window might not even see the other planes. Whether the separation distances involved would satisfy air-traffic-control regulations is another matter, although a working group at the International Civil Aviation Organisation has included the possibility of formation flying in a blueprint for new operational guidelines.

It remains to be seen how weather conditions affect the air flows that make formation flight more efficient. In zones of increased turbulence, the planes' wakes will decay more quickly and the effect will diminish. Dr. Kroo says this is one of the areas his team will investigate further. It might also be hard for airlines to co-ordinate the departure times and destinations of passenger aircraft in a way that would allow them to gain from formation flight. Cargo aircraft, in contrast, might be easier to reschedule, as might routine military flights.

As it happens, America's armed forces are on the case already. Earlier this year the country's Defence Advanced Research Projects Agency announced plans to pay Boeing to investigate formation flight, though the programme has yet to begin. There are reports that some military aircraft flew in formation when they were low on fuel during the Second World War, but Dr. Lissaman says they are unsubstantiated. "My father was an RAF pilot and my cousin the skipper of a Lancaster lost over Berlin," he adds. So he should know.

blocks.en: Findings of the Stanford University researchers will promote the sales of new Boeing and Airbus aircraft.
blocks.zh: 斯坦福大学研究者的发现将促进波音和空客新型飞机的销售。
blocks.exp: 定位第一段③句：研究者的建议是取法自然来省油，而且 it would not require them to buy new aircraft——不必买新飞机。既然如此，这项发现不会给新机型促销，陈述与原文相反，故 F。干扰在于首段前两句确实夸了新机型的效率，但那只是引子。

blocks.en: The upwash experience may save propelling energy as well as reducing resistance.
blocks.zh: 利用上洗流的经验既能减少阻力，也能节省推进所需的能量。
blocks.exp: 定位第二段④句 Other birds flying in the upwash experience reduced drag, and spend less energy propelling themselves：既 reduced drag（减少阻力），又 spend less energy propelling（省推进能量），与陈述的 as well as 结构对应，故 T。此题是原文同义转述。

blocks.en: Formation flight is more comfortable because passengers can not see the other planes.
blocks.zh: 编队飞行更舒适，因为乘客看不到其他飞机。
blocks.exp: 定位第四段③至⑤句：克鲁只说飞机可相隔数海里、乘客 might not even see the other planes，所以"不会因看得见而紧张"，用的是 could、might 的推测语气。陈述据此推出 more comfortable，把"不因此不适"偷换成"更舒适"，故 F。

blocks.en: The role that weather plays in formation flight has not yet been clearly defined.
blocks.zh: 天气在编队飞行中所起的作用尚未被清楚地界定。
blocks.exp: 定位第五段首句 It remains to be seen how weather conditions affect the air flows that make formation flight more efficient，即天气影响有待研究、尚未明确，与陈述 has not yet been clearly defined 对应，故 T。下句讲紊乱气流中效果减弱，也仍是待研究状态。

blocks.en: It has been documented that during World War II, America's armed forces once tried formation flight to save fuel.
blocks.zh: 有记载表明，二战期间美国军队曾尝试用编队飞行来节省燃油。
blocks.exp: 定位末段③④句：There are reports that some military aircraft flew in formation ... but Dr. Lissaman says they are unsubstantiated——只是"有报道"且被指为未证实。陈述用 has been documented（有据可查），与之直接冲突，故 F。

sections.title: Section III　翻译
sections.dir: In this section there is a text in English. Translate it into Chinese. Write your translation on ANSWER SHEET 2. (15 points)
sections.note: 难点是 sustainability：字面"可持续性"，文中指扛住困境的"承受力"，前后要统一；首句动名词主语转成"在……之后"。

paras.en: "Sustainability" has become a popular word these days, but to Ted Ning, the concept will always have personal meaning. Having endured a painful period of unsustainability in his own life made it clear to him that sustainability-oriented values must be expressed through everyday action and choice.
paras.zh: "承受力"近来成了一个流行词，但对泰德·宁（Ted Ning）来说，这个概念永远具有个人的意义。在自己的生活中熬过了一段难以承受的痛苦时期之后，他清楚地认识到：以承受力为导向的价值观，必须通过日常的行动和选择来体现。

paras.en: Ning recalls spending a confusing year in the late 1990s selling insurance. He'd been through the dot-com boom and burst and, desperate for a job, signed on with a Boulder agency.
paras.zh: 宁回忆起 20 世纪 90 年代后期那一年，他满心困惑地推销保险。他经历过互联网泡沫的膨胀与破灭，在急需一份工作的情况下，与博尔德（Boulder）的一家代理公司签了约。

paras.en: It didn't go well. "It was a really bad move because that's not my passion," says Ning, whose dilemma about the job translated, predictably, into a lack of sales. "I was miserable. I had so much anxiety that I would wake up in the middle of the night and stare at the ceiling. I had no money and needed the job. Everyone said, 'Just wait, you'll turn the corner, give it some time.'"
paras.zh: 事情并不顺利。"那一步走得很糟，因为那不是我热爱的事，"宁说。不出所料，他在工作上的两难处境转化成了销售业绩的惨淡。"我很痛苦。我焦虑到半夜惊醒、盯着天花板。我没有钱，又需要这份工作。大家都说：'等等吧，情况会好转的，给它一点时间。'"

words: 互联网（dot-com）泡沫的膨胀与破灭

sections.title: Section IV Part A　应用文（感谢信 + 邀请）
sections.dir: You have just come back from the U.S. as a member of a Sino-American cultural exchange program. Write a letter to your American colleague to 1) express your thanks for his/her warm reception, and 2) welcome him/her to visit China in due course. (about 100 words)
sections.note: 两个要点缺一不可：先谢接待（举一个具体细节，别只喊“感谢”），再发出回访邀请。署名 Zhang Wei，不写地址。
sections.sample:
Dear John,

I have just returned to Beijing from the United States, and I am writing to thank you for the warm reception you gave me during my stay as a member of the Sino-American cultural exchange program.

Your thoughtful arrangements made me feel at home: the campus tour, the dinners with your colleagues, and your patient explanations of American customs all helped me settle in quickly and understand your culture far better than any book could.

I would be delighted to welcome you to China in due course. Do let me know your schedule, and I will gladly show you around Beijing.

Yours sincerely,
Zhang Wei
tips: 第一段就要把“已回国 + 感谢接待”说清，不要用 I am writing to you 这种空转的开头
感谢要落到细节（campus tour / dinners / explanations），比连说三个 thank you 更能拿分
第二段必须完成第 2 个要点：明确邀请对方“适时”访华（in due course），并给一个具体承诺（show you around）

sections.title: Section IV Part B　图表作文
sections.dir: In this section, you are asked to write an essay based on the following chart. In your writing, you should 1) interpret the chart and 2) give your comments. (about 150 words)
sections.note: 折线图：2000—2008 年手机用户，发展中国家 5 亿→40 亿，发达国家 7 亿→10 亿。得分点在两条线的反差与归因。
sections.sample:
The chart shows the number of mobile-phone subscriptions in developing and developed countries from 2000 to 2008. In developing countries the figure climbed steeply, from 0.5 billion to 4 billion - an eightfold increase in only eight years. In developed countries, by contrast, it rose merely from 0.7 billion to 1 billion and has hardly moved since 2005.

Two factors explain the gap. First, the mobile market in developing countries is far from saturation: with a huge population, there is still an enormous pool of potential subscribers. Second, sustained economic growth has put a phone within the reach of ordinary families, so more and more people join the network each year. In developed countries, however, nearly everyone already owns one, which leaves little room for further expansion.

In my view, the trend will continue for a while but will slow down as the developing market matures. For manufacturers, the message is clear: future growth depends on cheaper handsets and services for first-time users in poorer regions.
tips: 第一段只读数：发展中国家的起点终点与倍数、发达国家的起点终点，两条线一定要对照着写
第二段解释差异的两个原因（市场未饱和 + 经济增长），这是本题最容易拉开差距的地方
第三段给趋势判断：增长会持续但会随市场成熟而放缓；不要另起新论点，一句话收住
